name: wads-ponto
description: Servidor MCP para registro de trabalho com Firebase.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run build --workspace @work-track/backend && node --test scripts/demo-generator.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace @work-track/backend && npx -y firebase-tools@15.33.0 emulators:start --config firebase.emulators.json --project demo-work-track --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.deploy: npm run check && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=./.firebase-cli npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only functions,hosting,auth,firestore:rules --project wadsworktrack
